summary: Guardforce AI Co., Limited, a Singapore-domiciled Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the outcome of its adjourned extraordinary general meeting held November 3, 2026 (adjourned from October 27 due to lack of quorum). Shareholders approved all three proposals: a special-resolution Capital Reorganization (40-for-1 share consolidation, capital reduction to US$0.001 par, and subsequent subdivision) and re-designation of share capital with a new memorandum and articles; the third ordinary resolution passed by simple majority. Roughly 32.38% of the 31,958,004 outstanding shares were represented. No board recommendation, advisor, or price terms apply; these are routine capital-structure and charter amendments, not a special situation.
